head: 9ff1b186364cf3a0758e344d669224e7a46dfdae
title: Honor explicit LightFM ID mapping values during evaluation
body:
### Description

`prepare_test_df` currently indexes the dictionary's key order to recover external IDs, ignoring the explicit internal indices stored in its values. Reconstructing an equivalent mapping in a different insertion order silently associates the same rating with a different user/item pair. NumPy conversion can also turn mixed integer/string IDs into strings.

Build the reverse lookups from the mapping values and apply them to the selected internal indices. Preserve external ID types and selected-row order, including repeated or Boolean selections. Return correctly typed empty columns for an empty selection. Clarify that the input mappings go from external IDs to internal indices.

Fixes #2480.

### Native validation

[Independent validation](https://github.com/Afloat16/recommenders/actions/runs/43919031831) checks exact head `9ff1b186364cf3a0758e344d669224e7a46dfdae` using native LightFM 1.17:

| Environment | Original suite | New cases on baseline | Patched full suite |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Python 3.10, NumPy 1.24.4, SciPy 1.10.1 | 4 passed, 1 skipped | 22 failed, 8 passed | 34 passed, 1 skipped |
| Python 3.11, NumPy 1.26.4, SciPy 1.13.1 | 4 passed, 1 skipped | 22 failed, 8 passed | 34 passed, 1 skipped |

The skip is the existing flaky `test_fitting`; every new case runs. Local Python 3.12 gives the same results. Black and `git diff --check` pass.

Tests create mappings and weighted interactions with the actual LightFM `Dataset`, then compare complete output DataFrames with the original external-ID records. Coverage combines:

- strings, large integers and mixed IDs that distinguish `42` from `"42"`;
- original and independently reordered user/item mappings;
- full, sliced, repeated, Boolean and empty selections;
- exact rating values, column dtypes, pair order and unchanged mappings.

No dataset, mapping method or sparse operation is mocked.

### History review

Reviewed 1,497 pre-existing upstream PR heads, 69 fork branches and all 28 reachable utility versions across 110 commits, including older paths and intermediate revisions. The prior #2272/#2273 work reduces test-data preparation overhead but still indexes cached key arrays in insertion order. This correction concerns the ID association and preserves vectorized rating lookup.

### Checklist

- [x] Contribution guidelines and code style followed.
- [x] Native regression coverage added to the existing LightFM test module.
- [x] Mapping direction documented.
- [x] Commit includes the required `Signed-off-by` trailer.
- [x] Targets `staging`.
